numbers_that_moved.quantity: prefix at which the FIFO control first fails, k=2
numbers_that_moved.explanation: at prefix i=2 the reservoir is {1,2} with 1 the oldest, so on acceptance FIFO always yields {2,3} and never {1,3}; the deviation is already maximal at i=3

numbers_that_moved.quantity: relative max deviation of unrepaired sum-mod-k at its first failing prefix, k=4
numbers_that_moved.explanation: the exact DP gives m1_rel = k-1 at the first failing prefix i=k+1, because the single source [k] must send all of its accepted mass to one of its k children

requirements.support_note: support == i for every prefix i > k; at i == k it is 1 because C(k,k) = 1

MAIN_S1.description: An exactly-uniform anytime reservoir sampler exists whose eviction step costs far less than the classical log2(k) bits per acceptance.
requirements: exact DP M1 == 0 at EVERY prefix of EVERY screened cell for S1 and S1f
min eviction entropy / log2(k) <= 0.25 on at least half the screened fiber steps
analytic bit saving at k=10 >= 20% of the classical total

C1_S5CIRC.description: A k-memory sampler exists with exactly-uniform first-order marginals and a broken joint law -- i.e. the standard first-order uniformity test is blind.
requirements: exact inclusion vector deviation == 0 at every prefix
exact total variation >= 0.9 on the screened cells

candidate_descriptions.S0: baseline classical Algorithm R: accept k/i, evict a uniformly random held item
candidate_descriptions.S1: sum-mod-k deterministic eviction, minimally repaired by min-cost transportation flow
candidate_descriptions.S1n: sum-mod-k deterministic eviction, NO repair (zero eviction randomness)
candidate_descriptions.S1f: flow-optimal eviction: integral certificate where k|(i+1), min-cost repair elsewhere
candidate_descriptions.S5-CIRC: circular-window sampler: exact first-order marginals, support of size i only
candidate_descriptions.C-OFFBY1: control: accept k/(i-1) instead of k/i
candidate_descriptions.C-FIFO: control: correct accept coin, evict the oldest held item
candidate_descriptions.C-RR: control: correct accept coin, evict round-robin by slot pointer
candidate_descriptions.C-SLOT0: control: correct accept coin, always overwrite slot 0
candidate_descriptions.C-NOACCEPT: control: correct accept coin, deterministically evict the largest held index
